subject: Resolve RTD empty dataset and Danskvand missing promo columns
description:
F20. Blocks P0033 premise that a CSD notebook can be mirrored three times.

RTD: rtd_clean_facts_v.parquet is 0 rows x 0 columns -- an EMPTY FILE. dim_market/dim_period exist (86 markets, 37 periods) but there are no facts. RTD cannot be modelled until re-exported. Decide: re-export from source DB, or drop RTD from scope (SRQ1 currently claims four categories).

Danskvand: 15 columns vs CSD 32. NO promotional measures at all -- no sales_units_any_promo, no baseline_*, no weighted_distribution_* promo variants. promo_units / promo_intensity / has_promo are NOT COMPUTABLE. Decide: accept a reduced feature set (and document the asymmetry in Ch6, since SRQ1 compares ranking "on identical data" -- which would no longer be identical), or re-export if the measures exist upstream.

Energidrikke: naming drift -- weighted_distribution_disp_wo_feat / _feat_wo_disp vs CSD _disp_w_o_feat / _feat_w_o_disp. Same measures, different spelling. Shared code matching exact names silently drops them.

ARCHITECTURE DECISION (Brian question: remove the notebook-specific engineering or the shared one?). Evidence supports neither extreme: fully shared cannot work (Danskvand lacks promo, RTD lacks everything); fully per-notebook duplicates leakage-prone logic 3-4x, which is what P0036 exists to prevent -- V3/V4 and the bfill fix were each made ONCE because the module is shared.
Recommended: shared CORE (make_calendar / filter_series / engineer_features / lags -- these operate on the post-aggregation frame whose schema IS uniform) + per-category capability declaration at the AGGREGATION step (promo: yes/no, baseline: yes/no) so absent measure families are skipped rather than assumed.

Also note (F21): product_id is not globally unique across categories, so any pooled/cross-category modelling must not join on it.

Verify: RTD status determined; Danskvand feature-set decision recorded with its Ch6 comparability implication; written architecture decision for shared vs per-notebook.
activeForm: Resolving RTD and Danskvand data gaps
